policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 13. Record ten confirmed mathematics, astronomy, optics, and chemistry science targets as verify-only science_retained checkpoints. No Person domain write is requested; all ten must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Choose a low-ambiguity mathematics/astronomy/optics/chemistry cohort with verified live knowledge status and verified latest numbered-batch assignment provenance. Exclude genuine philosophy-science or technology-science boundary cases and any Person whose latest provenance is not established.

science_retained.basis: Aryabhata's representative identity is mathematics and mathematical astronomy, especially the Aryabhatiya and its treatment of arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, and astronomical calculation. Under v2, mathematics and astronomy belong to science.

Al-Biruni's representative identity spans mathematics, astronomy, physics, geodesy, and empirical measurement. His historical identity is predominantly scientific despite substantial historical and cultural writings.
Brahmagupta's representative identity is mathematics and astronomy, with major contributions to number systems, algebraic methods, and mathematical astronomy. The v2 target is science.
Liu Hui is represented by mathematics, especially his commentary on the Nine Chapters and work in geometry and numerical methods. Mathematics and formal inquiry belong to v2 science.

Ibn al-Haytham's representative identity is experimental and mathematical optics, vision science, astronomy, and physics. His Book of Optics and reform of physical inquiry make science the clear representative domain.

Al-Battani's representative identity is observational astronomy and mathematics, including precise stellar, lunar, and planetary measurements and mathematical astronomical methods. The v2 target is science.

Ramanujan's representative identity is pure mathematics, especially number theory, infinite series, continued fractions, and related analysis. Mathematics and formal inquiry are explicitly within v2 science.

Banach's representative identity is pure mathematics and the foundation of modern functional analysis, with major work in topological vector spaces, measure, and integration. The v2 target is science.
Fibonacci's representative identity is mathematics, particularly arithmetic and number methods transmitted and developed through Liber Abaci. Under v2, mathematics is science.
Mendeleev's representative identity is chemistry, especially formulation of the periodic law and organization of the elements into the periodic system. The v2 target is science.
